bundle.shortDescription: CaPilot IDE — AI Agent 编排工作台
bundle.longDescription:
CaPilot IDE 是一个以 IDE 为中心的 AI Agent 编排工作台，支持 master/worker 多代理协作、终端 PTY、ESP 遥控器与版本控制。

CaPilot IDE is an IDE-centric AI agent orchestration workbench featuring master/worker multi-agent collaboration, PTY terminals, an ESP remote, and version control.
